items: The compliance officer asked Nora and ____ to review the revised disclosure form.
'Me' is part of the compound object of 'asked', so the object pronoun is required.
____ will accompany the engineering team during tomorrow's site inspection.
'They' is the subject of 'will accompany', so the subject pronoun is required.
The revised insurance policy applies to all contractors, including Ms. Diaz and ____.
After the preposition 'including', 'him' is required as the object pronoun.
Because ____ knows the client's reporting system well, Ms. Foster will lead the data migration.
'She' is the subject of 'knows', so the subject pronoun is required.
The purchasing assistant gave ____ the supplier's updated tax certificate.
'Us' is the indirect object of 'gave', so the object pronoun is required.
The new laboratory manager and ____ are scheduled to meet the safety inspector at nine.
'I' is part of the compound subject of 'are scheduled', so the subject pronoun is required.
The board secretary circulated the draft minutes to the directors and ____ before the vote.
After the preposition 'to', 'them' is part of the compound object, so the object pronoun is required.
If ____ need additional samples, the quality team can prepare them this afternoon.
'We' is the subject of 'need', so the subject pronoun is required.
The account representative called ____ after the customer requested a revised quotation.
'Her' is the object of 'called', so the object pronoun is required.
____ is responsible for confirming that the export license remains valid.
'He' is the subject of 'is responsible', so the subject pronoun is required.
The workshop facilitator divided the participants into groups and placed Luis with ____.
After the preposition 'with', the object pronoun 'me' is required.
While ____ was reviewing the lease, Mr. Adams noticed an incorrect renewal date.
'He' is the subject of 'was reviewing', so the subject pronoun is required.
The payroll system automatically sends ____ a notice when a timesheet is incomplete.
'Them' is the indirect object of 'sends', so the object pronoun is required.
Neither Ms. Kim nor ____ has received the final agenda for the budget meeting.
'She' is part of the compound subject of 'has received', so the subject pronoun is required.
The facilities director asked Priya and ____ to inspect the emergency lighting on the second floor.
'Us' is part of the compound object of 'asked', so the object pronoun is required.
Since ____ oversees the warranty claims, Mr. Lopez should respond to the manufacturer's inquiry.
'He' is the subject of 'oversees', so the subject pronoun is required.
The travel desk booked adjacent seats for Ms. Weber and ____ on the morning train.
After the preposition 'for', 'me' is part of the compound object, so the object pronoun is required.
____ have been authorized to negotiate directly with the landlord about the renewal terms.
'They' is the subject of 'have been authorized', so the subject pronoun is required.
The branch coordinator asked the delivery driver to contact ____ upon arrival at the loading dock.
'Us' is the object of 'contact', so the object pronoun is required.
After the vendor demonstration, ____ will prepare a recommendation for the procurement committee.
'She' is the subject of 'will prepare', so the subject pronoun is required.
The legal adviser explained the confidentiality clause to Marcus and ____ before they signed the agreement.
After the preposition 'to', 'me' is part of the compound object, so the object pronoun is required.
Only ____ were given temporary access to the archived personnel records.
'They' is the subject of 'were given', so the subject pronoun is required.
The conference host introduced Dr. Tanaka and ____ to the keynote speaker before lunch.
'Her' is part of the compound object of 'introduced', so the object pronoun is required.
When ____ complete the equipment checklist, the supervisor will authorize the shipment.
'We' is the subject of 'complete', so the subject pronoun is required.
The support engineer sent ____ detailed instructions for restoring the database backup.
'Him' is the indirect object of 'sent', so the object pronoun is required.
